evals.name: editorial-prestige-frontmatter-scaffold
evals.prompt: Generate a production-ready DESIGN.md for 'Chronicle Press' using the editorial-prestige archetype in YAML frontmatter mode, and verify it passes the 12-point audit gate.
evals.expected_output: A spec-compliant DESIGN.md with normative YAML frontmatter tokens, 8 canonical ## sections, specific reference prose, and a 100/100 audit report.

assertions.text: Starts with YAML frontmatter defining version, name, colors, typography, rounded, spacing, and components
Contains all 8 canonical ## sections in order (Overview, Colors, Typography, Layout, Elevation & Depth, Shapes, Components, Do's and Don'ts)
All {path.to.token} references resolve with 0 broken-ref errors
All component backgroundColor and textColor pairs pass WCAG AA >= 4.5:1 contrast

evals.name: interleaved-yaml-and-tailwind-v4-export
evals.prompt: Generate a DESIGN.md in interleaved YAML mode for 'Pulse Telemetry' (atmospheric-minimal archetype) and export its tokens to a Tailwind v4 @theme CSS block.
evals.expected_output: An interleaved DESIGN.md with fenced yaml blocks per section and a compiled @theme CSS block with --color-*, --font-*, --text-*, --radius-*, and --spacing-* custom properties.

assertions.text: Places fenced yaml blocks inside ## Colors, ## Typography, ## Layout, ## Shapes, and ## Components without duplicating top-level keys
Outputs valid @theme { ... } CSS custom properties block
